function read<K extends string | number>(k: K, r: Record<string, number>): number {
  return r[k];
}
function write<K extends string | number>(k: K, r: Record<string, number>): void {
  r[k] = 1;
}
function literalKeys<K extends "a" | 1>(k: K, r: Record<string, number>): number {
  return r[k];
}
function fromNumberRecord<K extends string>(k: K, r: Record<number, number>): number {
  return r[k];
}
function fromArray<K extends string | number>(k: K, r: number[]): number {
  return r[k];
}
function fromEither<K extends string | number>(k: K, r: Record<string, number> | { [key: string]: number }): number {
  return r[k];
}
function fromSignature<K extends string | number>(k: K, r: { [key: string]: number }): number {
  return r[k];
}
function byNumber<K extends number>(k: K, r: Record<string, number>): number {
  return r[k];
}
const key: keyof Record<string, number> = 1;
const mappedKey: keyof { [P in string]: number } = 2;
const signatureKey: keyof { [key: string]: number } = 3;
console.log(read, write, literalKeys, fromNumberRecord, fromArray, fromEither, fromSignature, byNumber);
console.log(key, mappedKey, signatureKey);
